scenario.title: The Quarry Workshop
scenario.premise: A small workshop supplying the village path makers.

stage.title: A trip to the quarry
stage.speaker: The path maker
stage.motivation: We need a sturdy carrier for coarse stones. Bring one to the quarry gate.
stage.travelText: The path makers stop at your workshop.

things.label: Hemp bundle
things.description: Fibres for making a coil of binding rope.

things.label: Twisting stick
things.description: A reusable tool for twisting fibres into rope.

things.label: Board kit
things.description: Prepared boards and their fasteners, enough for one closed crate.

things.label: Willow bundle
things.description: Flexible willow, enough for one open-weave basket.

locations.label: Quarry gate
locations.description: Bring a stone carrier here. The path makers take it on the collection trip and return it with gravel.
